descriptions.value: Type confusion in V8 in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.50 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to server-side request forgery. When service definitions are imported, references to external resources are not sufficiently restricted, so the server could be made to request resources it should not access.

descriptions.value: A vulnerability exists in a system component that may, under certain conditions, allow an authorized user to make unauthorized changes to system-managed content. Successful exploitation could affect system confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and may disrupt trusted interactions among system functions.
